PRODUCTS.title: Dry Fruit Mix
PRODUCTS.short: Nine nuts, seeds & berries slow-roasted in pure cow ghee.
PRODUCTS.desc: Our everyday hero jar. Hand-picked almonds, cashews and pistachios meet crunchy seeds and tangy berries, gently roasted in small batches with pure cow ghee. No preservatives, no added sugar: just a handful of real energy for office desks, school tiffins and evening cravings.

PRODUCTS.title: Badam
PRODUCTS.short: Whole, crunchy almonds, hand-sorted and packed fresh.
PRODUCTS.desc: Plain whole almonds (badam), cleaned and hand-sorted so you get only full, crunchy nuts. Soak a few overnight for your morning routine, add them to kheer and halwa, or snack straight from the jar. Nothing added.

PRODUCTS.title: Kaju
PRODUCTS.short: Whole, creamy cashews, hand-sorted and packed fresh.
PRODUCTS.desc: Plain whole cashews (kaju), cleaned and hand-sorted for full, creamy nuts. Perfect for snacking, curries, mithai and gifting. Nothing added.

PRODUCTS.title: Kishmish
PRODUCTS.short: Plump, naturally sweet raisins, packed fresh.
PRODUCTS.desc: Plump kishmish (raisins), cleaned and packed fresh. Naturally sweet: add them to kheer, halwa, poha and pulao, or eat a handful with your morning badam. Nothing added.

PRODUCTS.title: Snack Mix
PRODUCTS.short: A 13-ingredient wellness mix with rose petals & seeds.
PRODUCTS.desc: Our most colourful jar. Nuts, black and yellow kharek, raisins and currants meet flax, sesame, fennel and sunflower seeds, with a fragrant touch of rose petals. A nutrient-dense handful that works as a mukhwas, a mid-day snack or a breakfast topper.

PRODUCTS.title: Dry Fruit Khajur Pak
PRODUCTS.short: Ghar-jaisa Khajur Pak, sweetened only with dates & honey.
PRODUCTS.desc: The recipe that started it all. Soft dates are slow-cooked and folded with cashews, almonds, pistachios and seeds, then set into melt-in-mouth squares. Naturally sweet from dates and honey, with no refined sugar. Perfect as a morning energy bite or a guilt-free mithai.

PRODUCTS.title: Dry Fruit Mix + Khajur Pak Combo
PRODUCTS.short: Our two bestsellers together: 400 g each.
PRODUCTS.desc: Everyday snacking meets traditional indulgence. One jar of our ghee-roasted Dry Fruit Mix and one box of dates-sweetened Khajur Pak: the combo our customers gift the most.

PRODUCTS.title: Trail Mix
PRODUCTS.short: Nuts, seeds, kharek & three kinds of raisins.
PRODUCTS.desc: Built for long days and longer drives. Crunchy nuts and seeds balanced with naturally sweet kharek and raisins: steady energy without the sugar crash.

PRODUCTS.title: Roasted & Salted Dry Fruit Mix
PRODUCTS.short: Seven nuts & seeds kissed with Himalayan pink salt.
PRODUCTS.desc: A clean, savoury crunch for chai-time. Cashews, almonds, pistachios and hazelnuts are dry-roasted with three kinds of seeds and finished with a light dusting of Himalayan pink salt. Satisfies the namkeen craving without the fried-snack guilt.

PRODUCTS.title: Masala Dryfruit Mix
PRODUCTS.short: Ghee-roasted nuts tossed in our house chatpata masala.
PRODUCTS.desc: For the namkeen lovers. Almonds, cashews, raisins and seeds are roasted in cow ghee and tossed in a balanced house masala: chatpata, not fiery. Your new favourite companion for chai, travel and movie nights.

PRODUCTS.title: Masala Cashew
PRODUCTS.short: Whole cashews coated in authentic Indian spices.
PRODUCTS.desc: Plump whole cashews, roasted till crisp and coated in a bold blend of Indian spices. No artificial flavours, no preservatives: just a seriously addictive tea-time snack.

PRODUCTS.title: Protein Beans Mix
PRODUCTS.short: Roasted soy, edamame & black beans: plant protein crunch.
PRODUCTS.desc: A light, crunchy hit of plant protein. Soybeans, edamame and black beans are slow-roasted without any added flavours or preservatives. Great after a workout, between meetings, or as a smart swap for chips.

PRODUCTS.title: Seed Mix with Haldi
PRODUCTS.short: Pumpkin, sunflower & watermelon seeds with turmeric & pink salt.
PRODUCTS.desc: Tiny seeds, big goodness. Three seeds are gently roasted with haldi and pink salt for an earthy, mildly salty crunch. Sprinkle on salads, poha and soups, or snack on it by the spoonful.

PRODUCTS.title: Classic Granola
PRODUCTS.short: Crunchy oats & nuts clustered with jaggery and peanut butter.
PRODUCTS.desc: Breakfast, sorted. Whole oats are baked into golden clusters with almonds, cashews and seeds, bound with jaggery and peanut butter instead of refined sugar. Pour it over milk or curd, or eat it straight from the jar.

PRODUCTS.title: Seven In One Combo
PRODUCTS.short: All 7 bestsellers in full-size jars. Our biggest saving.
PRODUCTS.desc: The complete Meva Mantra pantry in one box. Seven full-size packs covering energy, protein, immunity and pure snacking joy: enough for the whole family for weeks.

PRODUCTS.title: Snacking Combo (Small Pack)
PRODUCTS.short: Seven trial-size jars: find your favourite.

FAQS.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
FAQS.a: UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), debit/credit cards, net banking, wallets and Cash on Delivery. Prepaid orders get an extra 5% off automatically at checkout.
Yes, within 2 hours of placing it. After that the order moves to packing. If you need help, WhatsApp us with your order ID.

FAQS.q: How do I apply a coupon?
FAQS.a: Enter the code in the cart or on the checkout page. Try MANTRA10 for 10% off your first order above ₹499.

We pack fresh after you order (2–3 working days), dispatch within 1–2 days, and couriers deliver in 3–7 working days depending on your pincode. Use the pincode checker on any product page for an estimate.
Shipping is free on orders above ₹500. A flat ₹49 is charged on smaller orders.

FAQS.q: How do I track my order?
FAQS.a: You get tracking on WhatsApp and email once shipped. You can also use the Track Order page with your order ID and mobile number.

FAQS.q: What if my order arrives damaged?
FAQS.a: Tell us within 48 hours of delivery with your order ID and photos/video. We will arrange a free replacement or refund.

FAQS.q: Can I return an opened jar?
FAQS.a: For hygiene reasons, opened or partially consumed food items cannot be returned unless they were damaged or incorrect.
No. Everything is made in small batches with natural ingredients and no preservatives, artificial colours, flavours or sweeteners.

FAQS.q: How should I store the jars?
FAQS.a: Close the lid tightly and store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight. Khajur Pak keeps best in the refrigerator during summer.

FAQS.q: Is Khajur Pak suitable for diabetics?
FAQS.a: It has no refined sugar but is naturally sweet from dates and honey. Please consult your doctor before including it in a diabetic diet.

FAQS.q: Do you take bulk or corporate orders?
FAQS.a: Yes! We customise boxes with your logo and message for corporate gifting, weddings and festivals. Use the bulk enquiry form on the Contact page.

FAQS.q: Can I add a gift message?
FAQS.a: Yes. Tick “Gift wrap + message” in the cart (₹49) and write your note. We hand-write it on a card.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
body: Freshly packed
Every order is packed fresh after you place it. Preparation takes 2–3 working days.
Dispatch & delivery
Orders are dispatched within 1–2 working days of preparation through trusted courier partners and usually reach you within 3–7 working days, depending on your location.
Shipping charges
Free shipping on orders above ₹500. A flat ₹49 applies to smaller orders.
Tracking
Tracking details are shared on WhatsApp and email as soon as your parcel is dispatched.
Delivery attempts
Couriers make up to three delivery attempts. Undelivered parcels return to us; prepaid refunds are processed after deducting two-way shipping.
Changes to your order
Address or item changes are possible until the order is packed. Contact us on WhatsApp quickly.

refund.title: Returns, Refunds & Cancellation

Report within 48 hours of delivery with your order ID and clear photos/video. We will arrange a replacement or refund after verification.
Return conditions
Products must be unused and in original packaging. Opened or partially consumed food items cannot be returned unless damaged or incorrect.
Refunds
Approved refunds go back to the original payment method within 5–7 working days, or as store credit if you prefer.
Cancellation
Orders can be cancelled within 2 hours of placing them for a full refund. After packing begins, cancellation may not be possible.
Non-returnable
Clearance items, festive hampers after delivery and personalised gift boxes.

POSTS.title: One Muththi a Day: Why a Handful of Dry Fruits Matters
POSTS.excerpt: Small habit, big difference: how a daily handful of nuts and seeds supports energy, focus and heart health.
body: A muththi, roughly 30 grams, is the sweet spot for most adults. It is enough to give you healthy fats, plant protein and fibre without overdoing calories.
Almonds and pistachios bring vitamin E and protein; cashews add magnesium; pumpkin and sunflower seeds contribute zinc and iron. Together they keep you full longer than biscuits or chips.
The trick is consistency. Keep a jar on your desk, carry a small box in your bag, and swap one packaged snack a day for a handful of real food.

POSTS.title: The Story of Our Khajur Pak
POSTS.excerpt: From a family recipe to your doorstep: what makes ghar-jaisa Khajur Pak different.
body: Khajur Pak is one of those sweets every Gujarati home has a version of. Ours uses only dates and a little honey for sweetness: no sugar syrup, no shortcuts.
The dates are slow-cooked until they melt, then folded with roasted cashews, almonds, pistachios and seeds. It is set, cut by hand and packed the same day.
The result is a sweet you can eat at breakfast without guilt, and one that grandparents and kids both love.

POSTS.title: 5 Desk Snacks That Beat the 4 PM Slump
POSTS.excerpt: Swap the vending machine for these protein-packed, no-junk options.
body: The 4 PM slump is real, and sugary snacks only make it worse. Protein and fibre keep energy steady.
Try roasted protein beans, a masala dry fruit mix, seed mix with haldi, granola with curd, or two squares of Khajur Pak with green tea.
Pre-portion them into small boxes on Sunday so the healthy choice is also the easy one.

POSTS.title: The Healthy Diwali Gifting Guide
POSTS.excerpt: Gifts that feel premium and are actually good for the people you love.
body: Festive gifting does not have to mean boxes of sugar. Dry fruit hampers and dates-based sweets feel just as indulgent.
For family, pick a combo that covers sweet and savoury. For corporate teams, windowed Khajur Pak boxes with a printed message look premium and travel well.
Order early: festive batches are made fresh and limited.
